definitions.explanation: A condition where a bone is displaced from its normal position at a joint.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{脱臼|だっきゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I fell and dislocated my shoulder.

examples.japanese: {脱臼|だっきゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Dislocations need to be treated promptly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脱臼|だっきゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|なお}り→治る：19598_naoru⟧やすい。
examples.english: A dislocated finger is painful but heals easily.

notes:
{脱臼|だっきゅう} refers to a joint dislocation — when a bone is displaced from its normal position. Composed of {脱|だつ} (remove, escape) + {臼|きゅう} (mortar, socket).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱臼|だっきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dislocate
- {脱臼|だっきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to suffer a dislocation
- {脱臼|だっきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治|なお}す→治す：19371_naosu⟧: to reduce/fix a dislocation
- ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脱臼|だっきゅう}: shoulder dislocation
- ⟦{顎|あご}→顎：04266_ago⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脱臼|だっきゅう}: jaw dislocation

USAGE:
⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧ (shoulder) is the most commonly dislocated joint. ⟦{顎|あご}→顎：04266_ago⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{脱臼|だっきゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ (dislocated jaw) can happen from yawning widely — a surprisingly common topic in everyday conversation.
